production_notes: The generated source atlases are preserved here. Cropping, downsampling and alpha thresholding prepared the sprites for Minecraft; the inventory preview enlarges the delivered pixels with nearest-neighbor sampling.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for ReTerra, a Minecraft ecology restoration mod. Create ONE precisely aligned 4 by 4 sprite sheet on a transparent background, square 1024x1024, sixteen equal 256x256 cells without gutters, no labels, no text, no grid lines. Each icon is a crisp Minecraft inventory item in authentic hand-painted 32x32 pixel-art style enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixel edges, limited colors, readable dark outlines, lighting from upper left. Every icon centered wholly inside its cell, leaving a 32-pixel empty transparent margin within its cell. Cohesive copper, weathered cream, dark soil, sage green palette. Row 1 left to right: rich brown organic compost pile with straw and tiny green organic flecks; sealed small glass vial containing living green grass with copper cap; sealed nutrient culture glass jar with amber liquid and green bubbles; cylindrical charcoal and woven fiber water filter cartridge with copper rim. Row 2: broken engraved research circuit tablet fragment, weathered copper and teal; preserved sheep biological sample glass vial with small white wool curl and cream tag; cow biological sample vial with brown hide patch and brown tag; chicken biological sample vial with small white feather and amber tag. Row 3: bee biological sample vial with gold honey droplet and black-yellow tag; weathered botanical field notebook with leaf embossed on cover; small tied waxed canvas recovery pouch with one green seed showing; handheld environmental scanner, copper housing, dark green display with small leaf signal, short antenna. Row 4: a salvaged precision copper rotor with four blades; compact sealed glass seed canister with 2 amber seeds; a woven roll of straw mulch; a simple metal water pump impeller. Pure isolated inventory sprites, no perspective boxes or backgrounds, no realistic rendering, no gradients, no shadows outside icon silhouette. Strict straight equal grid and transparency are essential.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Minecraft block texture atlas for ReTerra restoration machines. Create ONE square 1024x1024 image, precise 2x2 grid with four equal square 512x512 tiles, edge to edge, no margins, no labels, no lettering, no objects floating on backgrounds. Every tile is a flat orthographic full-block face texture in authentic 32x32 Minecraft pixel art enlarged with nearest neighbor edges. Dark outlines, restrained weathered iron, oxidized copper, sage green, mineral gray. Upper left tile: soil reclaimer front, weathered steel square face with a visible slatted compost hopper aperture, a small ochre soil processing window and copper rivets. Upper right tile: restoration core face, symmetrical weathered copper and dark stone casing with a luminous jade green leaf-shaped circuit and subtle branching root traces, machine readable as nature restoration equipment. Lower left tile: water filtration machine front, oxidized copper casing, a blue water level gauge, dark filter grille, metal pipe connection. Lower right tile: biological revival chamber front, pale weathered steel casing surrounding a green translucent culture viewing window, two small amber indicator lights and restrained copper trims. Frames must meet each tile's edges. Every surface is opaque pixel art. No modern smooth vector art, no 3D angled cubes, no bevel rendering, no text. This is game texture artwork, not a mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one opaque square Minecraft block face texture for ReTerra Heart of the World. A flat orthographic full face, edge to edge no margins. Authentic 32x32 pixel art enlarged to a square image, hard pixel edges, limited palette. Weathered copper rim with four pale brass corner rivets, deep slate stone inset, an intricate luminous golden seed encircled by sage green root and leaf circuits. Readable central glowing seed motif, gentle amber and jade accents, ancient ecological machine. Match Minecraft resource pack pixel art, no 3D perspective, no text, no gradients, no labels, no shadow outside frame.
